text:
jasmin_sales: Olga from Faraday wants an air-gapped POC in their colo. Requirements: customer-side HSM signing, weekly minibundles, monthly full, no vendor key escrow, ~45GB/week. Any immediate blockers?

noah_se: We can support BYOK for Private installs. Proposal: deliver unsigned delta minibundles + a signing-helper container (pkcs11) they run in their HSM jumpbox. Need HSM vendor and middleware details.

ters_infra: (tess_infra): Packaging caveat: pinned GPU drivers and custom kernels can bloat diffs. Recommend monthly fulls for migrations and keep weekly deltas non-migration only. Also need checksum algorithm (sha256).

drew_sec: Security redlines: Redwood must never receive private keys. Add SOW clause: "Customer retains sole custody of private keys; Redwood will not accept, receive, or store private key material." Also prefer local audit logs only.

olga_cust: Confirmed: Faraday uses nShield. They will run tools in a locked jumpbox and want a rollback playbook. Also asking about extra per-minibundle handling fees.

pkg-bot: created PKG-4022: signing-helper + nShield pkcs11 example + preflight checklist.

noah_se: Pricing sketch: one-time packaging + validation fee, then per-minibundle handling. I'll propose numbers after we run kernel/driver matrix tests.

jasmin_sales: Action items: @noah_se prototype signing helper + pkcs11 example, @tess_infra write preflight one-pager (disk, runtime, driver matrix), @drew_sec draft SOW wording. Meeting Thu 10am PT to review. :thumbsup:
